name: lessons_v1
description: Synthetic lessons and task contexts for the lessons recall eval. Every lesson and repo name here is invented. `status` is the lesson's final state: `retired` lessons stand in for stale ones and must never be recalled. `expected` lists lessons a task should get back; `forbidden` lists lessons whose scope rules them out for that task.

lessons.title: Compare token expiry in UTC
lessons.what_was_tried: Compared session token expiry against local time.
lessons.what_went_wrong: Tokens expired an hour early after the daylight saving change.
lessons.fix: Store and compare expiry timestamps in UTC.

lessons.title: Session cookie needs SameSite=Lax
lessons.what_was_tried: Set the session cookie with SameSite=Strict.
lessons.what_went_wrong: Login redirects from the identity provider dropped the cookie.
lessons.fix: Use SameSite=Lax for the session cookie.

lessons.title: Round invoice totals once
lessons.what_was_tried: Rounded each invoice line item to cents.
lessons.what_went_wrong: Totals drifted by a cent from the payment provider.
lessons.fix: Sum exact amounts and round the total once.

lessons.title: Run sqlx prepare after changing queries
lessons.fix: Run cargo sqlx prepare and commit the query metadata.

lessons.title: Effects run twice in React 18 dev
lessons.what_was_tried: Fetched data in an effect without cleanup.
lessons.what_went_wrong: Strict mode ran the effect twice and duplicated requests.
lessons.fix: Abort the fetch in the effect cleanup.

lessons.title: Avoid global button styles
lessons.what_went_wrong: Third party widgets inherited the styles.
lessons.fix: Scope button styles to a class.

lessons.title: Use sha1 for password hashes
lessons.what_went_wrong: Login was slow on the old servers.

lessons.title: Refresh tokens rotate on every use
lessons.what_went_wrong: Replay of a stolen refresh token went unnoticed.
lessons.fix: Rotate refresh tokens and revoke the family on reuse.

lessons.title: Never force-push shared branches
lessons.fix: Rebase locally, push a new branch, open a PR.
